title: Oily Outward Japanese Papelon Noodles
description: A traditional Chubu dish featuring papelon, served on a cedar plank, this recipe is perfect for a post-workout meal, with its jammy and bouncy texture, and is egg-free friendly.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
Add the noodles and cook according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sesame oil, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Add the papelon to the bowl and stir to combine.
Once the noodles are cooked, drain and set aside.
In the same pot, add the soy sauce mixture and bring to a simmer.
Deglaze the pot with the soy sauce mixture, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the cooked noodles back to the pot and toss to combine with the sauce.
Serve the noodles on the cedar plank, garnished with chopped green onions.
